_note: Hand corrections to the intent rules in aso.mjs. `intents` pins one exact tracked term to one bucket and beats every rule. `offtarget` is a substring list checked against the English form of a term, for whole neighbourhoods this app does not serve. Buckets: symptom (names the problem), category (names a tool), feature (names one capability), adjacent (a neighbouring need the app partly serves), brand (someone else's name), offtarget (not ours), mine (our own name).
_vetoNote: Words the keyword field will never carry, whatever demand sits behind them. Kept here so the shopping list and the field packer stop re-proposing a decision already made: lab and nhs squat on names that are not ours, ai was rejected on positioning.
